fact: The ministry and UNESCO held a workshop on 29 July to 2 August 2024 for the project, agreed in December 2022 and running 35 months to 14 February 2026, to build a human resources module integrated into the central SIGE and compatible with the STATEDUC application, for teacher recruitment, deployment and posting; activities were planned over 12 months and user profiles validated.

fact: The GPE Independent Technical Advisory Panel says the EMIS is not yet integrated with other education management infrastructure and data sources, including human resources management and examinations.
The Panel says the ministry of education is developing a human resources module to be integrated in the education management information system; no completion is stated.
